decisions.reason: Large bulk containers build directly on the firm's existing design, engineering and manufacturing knowledge, and the dedicated website presence indicates the firm can interpret and support the product.
The valve leverages the firm's materials and component expertise, though it is a more specialised extension, so there is a moderate risk but still within existing absorptive capacity.

The take-back service relies more on reverse logistics and service capabilities than on manufacturing knowledge, but the firm's rental and supply-chain operations provide a related base, giving it a moderate chance to learn and improve.
